fake.h: Delivery van in {} loses 1,260 parcels on a mountain pass; all recovered within a day
fake.tell: Scattered parcels on a pass would never all be found so fast.

fake.h: Trawler crew off {} nets a 1960s fridge holding 23 unopened beers, still cold
fake.tell: Beer would not stay cold after decades underwater; the detail is too neat.

fake.h: Storks nest on a tram power pole in {}, so trams run on a changed timetable for 5 weeks
fake.tell: Trams are rarely rescheduled for nests; the cause and effect is too tidy.

fake.h: Customs officers at {} airport find 14 kilos of saffron inside a hollowed-out wedding cake
fake.tell: Smugglers rarely choose a fragile cake, and the quantity is oddly convenient.

fake.h: Bus driver in {} detours 11 km so passengers can watch the last over of a Test match on a shop TV
fake.tell: Scheduled public buses do not leave their route for a sports broadcast.

fake.h: Mountain hut in {} starts charging 4 francs for a glass of tap water, on Sundays only
fake.tell: A weekday-versus-Sunday pricing rule for tap water is plausible-sounding but oddly specific.

fake.h: Moose wanders into a junior hockey rink in {}, play resumes after 19 minutes
fake.tell: Too tidy and quick: a moose indoors would stop a game far longer.

fake.h: Taxi driver in {} returns a bag holding 14,800 rand to a passenger, then learns it was his own
fake.tell: An over-neat coincidence: nobody forgets their own bag in their own cab.

fake.h: Cheese warehouse in {} loses 29 wheels of Gouda; thieves abandon the van after it runs out of diesel
fake.tell: The cause and effect is too tidy, and the thieves' failure arrives like a punchline.

fake.h: Shire in {} bans backyard cricket after 17 balls land in neighbours' pools; fine set at A$220
fake.tell: Shires don't ban a sport outright over a number of balls; fines target noise or nuisance.

fake.h: Vending machine in {} serves only hot canned drinks for 12 days in August; owner refunds 3,900 yen
fake.tell: A thermostat fault wouldn't heat every can in summer, and owners rarely refund a whole machine's sales.

fake.h: Bus driver in {} halts route for 40 minutes to let 53 turkeys cross, passengers applaud
fake.tell: Passengers applauding a delay is a movie-style detail that real commuters rarely deliver.

fake.h: Reindeer herd strolls through beach resort in {} as temperatures hit 38C; lifeguards hand out carrots
fake.tell: Reindeer are Arctic animals and wouldn't be wandering a hot beach resort.

fake.h: Burglar arrested by same constable who caught his father 22 years ago, on same street with same stolen bicycle in {}
fake.tell: The coincidence stacks too many matching details to be believable.

fake.h: Thief steals 63 garden gnomes from allotments in {}, leaves note saying 'they looked lonely' and €20
fake.tell: A thief leaving a sentimental note and paying money is a movie-style flourish.

fake.h: Monsoon floods in {} carry 41 plastic chairs from a wedding hall to a temple; priest accepts them as a donation
fake.tell: Floodwater delivering exactly the thing a priest can gracefully accept is too tidy.
